About us

Discover the story, mission, and people behind Abhyaas Pre-University College.

Our story

At Abhyaas PU College, we believe every student carries a spark of potential waiting to be discovered. We go beyond textbooks and exam scores to nurture confident, curious, and capable young individuals ready to take on the world.

Located in the serene surroundings of Ujire, Dakshina Kannada, our campus provides the perfect environment for focused learning and holistic growth.

Our approach

Experienced faculty don't just teach — they mentor and guide, taking the time to understand each student's learning style. Paired with modern infrastructure and innovative teaching methods, we create an environment where students don't just memorize concepts, but truly understand and apply them.

Integrated competitive exam coaching

We offer integrated coaching for top competitive entrance exams — KCET, NEET, JEE, NDA, CLAT, NAT, Banking, and many more — alongside regular board exam preparation. This means students prepare for both simultaneously, under one roof, with specialized faculty, regular mock tests, and personalized doubt-clearing sessions.

"At Abhyaas PU College, we prepare students not just for exams, but for life."

Join us, and let's build your future together.

Messages from leadership

Mr. Karthikeya M S
Chairman

"Education is the most powerful investment in the future. At Abhyaas PU College, we are dedicated to nurturing young minds through academic excellence, strong values, and holistic development. Our commitment is to empower every student with the knowledge, confidence and character to excel in life and become responsible global citizens."

Dr. Deepak K S
Principal

"At Abhyaas PU College, we believe that every student has the potential to achieve greatness. Through quality education, personalized mentoring, and a supportive learning environment, we inspire our students to dream big, work hard, and embrace every opportunity with confidence. Together, we strive to build a future defined by excellence and success."

Admissions

Your journey to excellence starts here

Admission process

Step 1: Enquiry

Fill out the online enquiry form or call us at +91 82960 03705

Step 2: Campus visit

Schedule a visit to explore our campus, labs, and hostel facilities

Step 3: Application

Submit the completed application form with required documents

Step 4: Document verification

Our team verifies your SSLC marks card and other documents

Step 5: Fee payment

Complete the admission fee payment to confirm your seat

Step 6: Welcome to Abhyaas!

Attend orientation and begin your journey towards excellence

Required documents

  • SSLC / 10th Marks Card (original + 2 copies)
  • Transfer Certificate (TC) from previous school
  • Birth Certificate
  • Aadhaar Card copy
  • Passport size photographs (4 copies)
  • Caste Certificate (if applicable)
  • Income Certificate (for scholarship)
